title: PES 0110 writes a region's stamp as PE-DESIGN's Convert from Outline does
description: design.export with pesVersion 11 writes a region's stamp (#608) as PE-DESIGN 11.50 writes one made with Stamp/Emboss > Convert from Outline (round-10 captures compat/reference/stitches/stamp-*-circle.pes, #959): a 16-byte record after the geometry header's marks (centre, size in 0.1 mm), the outline as the header's listed pattern in a 1024-unit cell, given again with head [2, 500, 1] for an engraved region. The design is stamp-engraved-region-circle's: the 40 mm Fill square at (30,30) mm with a 14.5 x 14.0 mm circle in the middle converted to an engraved region. Before, the exporter dropped stamps without a word.

evidence.note: docs/FILE_FORMATS.md, PES 0110 stamps (#959); engine test stamps_export_to_pes_0110_as_pe_design_writes_them compares the record and the listed pattern with the three captures

references.make: Run `stitchtool compat --only pes-0110-stamps` and open target/compat/work/pes-0110-stamps/a.pes in PE-DESIGN 11 (App menu > Open). Expected: a 40 mm square at (30,30) mm with a Fill region and, in its middle, a 14.5 x 14.0 mm circle shown as an engraved-region stamp (Stamp/Emboss > Edit Stamp Tool selects it), as compat/reference/stitches/stamp-engraved-region-circle.pes. Record in the MANIFEST notes: whether the file opens and with what warning, whether the stamp shows and with which effect, and the status-bar stitch count against that file's 3531. Then Save As PES, default type (Layout & Editing Ver.11.0 File, #PES0110), unchanged, under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md). If PE-DESIGN refuses the file or opens it blank, do not add a file: write what you saw in the notes of docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md instead.

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN 11's Layout & Editing Ver.11.0 file signature
stamp-engraved-region-circle.pes: one CEmbLine carrying the stamp; the reader parses the whole list
